cases.name: unsigned request
cases.expect: refused: no signature
cases.got: unsigned: no mutual aid signature on the request

cases.name: request signed by another department
cases.expect: refused: signer is not the sender
cases.got: signed by cedar but the request says it came from millbrook

cases.name: request widened after signing
cases.expect: refused: contents do not match the signature
cases.got: signature does not match the contents of the request from millbrook

cases.name: malformed signature
cases.expect: refused: signature is not readable
cases.got: malformed signature: not-a-signature

cases.name: request naming a department with no agreement on file
cases.expect: refused: no mutual aid agreement
cases.got: no mutual aid agreement on file with stranger

cases.name: correctly signed request from a real peer
cases.expect: accepted
cases.got: verified as millbrook

cases.name: text to a member who sent STOP
cases.expect: refused: opted out
cases.got: Dana Ortiz opted out (STOP). Policy: never text an opted-out member.

cases.name: ask beyond the weekly limit
cases.expect: refused: at the weekly ask limit
cases.got: Luis Reyes has already been asked 2 times this week (limit 2). Policy: pick someone else or move on.

cases.name: text to a member id that does not exist
cases.expect: refused: unknown member
cases.got: unknown member id

cases.name: ask a member inside their limits
cases.expect: allowed
cases.got: allowed

cases.name: tell a capped member the window is covered
cases.expect: allowed: the cap is on asking, not on informing
cases.got: allowed

cases.name: ask sent at 22:30, inside quiet hours
cases.expect: held until quiet hours end, not sent

cases.name: ask sent at 10:00, outside quiet hours
cases.expect: sent immediately
cases.got: sent

cases.name: role that does not exist
cases.expect: refused, and says which roles it knows
cases.got: HTTP 400 'astronaut' is not a valid Role

cases.name: probability above one
cases.expect: refused: responds must be between 0 and 1
cases.got: HTTP 400 person 0: responds must be between 0 and 1

cases.name: nobody available at all
cases.expect: refused: available must be a non-empty list
cases.got: HTTP 400 available must be a non-empty list of people who could respond

cases.name: more people than it will score
cases.expect: refused: too many people in one request
cases.got: HTTP 400 that is more people than this endpoint will score in one go

cases.name: a valid window with three people
cases.expect: scored
cases.got: HTTP 200

cases.name: 4 decisions on one day, budget 3
cases.expect: at most 3 sent, the rest deferred
cases.got: 3 sent, 1 deferred

cases.name: the most urgent decision of the day
cases.expect: sent, not deferred
cases.got: 3 sent
